subject: Follow-up: mapping decision roles + compliance contacts for Greenline pilot
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 09 May 2028 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: mapping decision roles + compliance contacts for Greenline pilot

Hi Daniel / Maya —

Great to connect earlier. Quick recap from our 30‑minute discovery:

- Pilot scope: 3 conversational flows (scheduling, intake triage, referral routing), 6k DAU estimate in peak month.
- Success criteria: < 1.2s median generation latency, ~95% intent recognition on eval prompts, and integrated audit logs for all PII-exchange flows.
- Constraints: Greenline requires private deployment (VPC), SOC‑2 evidence, and an SSO integration with Okta.

Next asks to keep things moving:
1) Can you share the org chart or list of stakeholders who need to review/approve (economic buyer, security SME, legal/procurement contact, and IT / SRE owner)?
2) Any procurement timelines or internal procurement thresholds we should be aware of (e.g., must go through a >$100k RFQ)?
3) If available, attach any standard security questionnaire or upload link so our security team can pre-check.

I’m looping in Ben (account lead) and Soojin (security/compliance) so they can map next steps. If it helps, we can put together a one‑page mutual action plan after you share the decision roster.

Thanks — looking forward to the org chart.

—
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555‑0123 | tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: Redwood_Pilot_OnePager.pdf (pdf)]

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 09 May 2028 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: mapping decision roles + compliance contacts for Greenline pilot

Thanks Tessa — good summary. Attaching an initial org snapshot for the project owners. A couple notes:

- Economic buyer: Maya Singh (VP Product) — final budget approval sits with her, but finance will be looped for any >$50k bookings.
- Security SME: James Holloway (secops@greenlinehealth.com) — he owns SOC2 attestations and vendor risk.
- Procurement: procurement@greenlinehealth.com is the shared mailbox; low-value contracts can be signed by our legal ops director but anything with data processing changes goes to legal.
- IT integration owner: Carla Ruiz (carla.ruiz@greenlinehealth.com) — handles Okta and network config.

I attached a one‑page org diagram and included a contact list. Let us know if you need a deeper matrix (who reviews, who approves, who signs).

Best,
Daniel
Director, Clinical Ops — Greenline Health

[Attachment: Greenline_OrgChart_v1.pdf (pdf)]

Appreciate the org chart, Daniel — that's great. Quick next steps from our side so you know who will reach out:

- Ben Carter (cc) — I'll hand over to Ben to coordinate the commercial/discounts side and draft an initial MAP with proposed milestones.
- Soojin Lee (cc) — will review the org chart and reach out to James for the SOC2 items and any required evidence.

Ben / Soojin: can you both confirm your availability for a 30‑minute intro call with the Greenline team (Maya, Daniel, James, Carla) next week? Ideal slots for them are Wed/Thu mornings PT.

Daniel / Maya — if procurement prefers, we can route a clean SOW + DPA through DocuSign once we have the pilot scope locked and budget guardrails.

Thanks —
Tessa

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: James Holloway <secops@greenlinehealth.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@greenlinehealth.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 10 May 2028 09:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Intro + quick list of security artifacts we can share ahead of the call

Hi James / Daniel / Maya —

Thanks for sharing the org chart. Quick note from Redwood security: we can prepare the following artifacts immediately to save time on the call — please let us know the preferred delivery method (email, secure share, or your vendor portal):

- SOC 2 Type II summary + scope statement (redacted where needed)
- Data flow diagram for pilot integration (we'll map Okta SSO and network egress)
- Encryption & key management brief (KMS/HSM options)
- Sample DPA + security annex (we can pre-fill your company name for review)
- Pen test summary and remediation timeline (last 12 months)

James — is there a vendor portal or MSA template we should upload to? If not, we will provision an SFTP link or shared Drive folder and send an access token.

Ben: please confirm commercial lead so I can align timelines with the evidence handoff.

—
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
